# Mandarin

> Mandarin is a live sports-betting tool at https://www.betmandarin.online that compares odds across US sportsbooks and flags two-sided arbitrage and positive expected-value differences.

Mandarin does not place bets. Prices come from a third-party odds provider and can change between a refresh and the moment a wager is placed. An arbitrage figure is only as good as the two prices still being available and accepted. Positive expected value is a long-run average: any single bet can lose. Nothing on the site is financial, tax, or legal advice. Whether betting is allowed depends on where the reader lives and on each sportsbook's rules.

The product prefers a sharp book's price (Pinnacle, when that line is present) as an anchor, removes that book's vig to estimate a fair probability, and compares bettable US books against that estimate. When Pinnacle is absent it can fall back to a consensus of several books. Two-sided arbitrage is shown separately from one-sided positive EV. Large outliers are flagged for verification because they are often stale or unbettable.

- [How it works](https://www.betmandarin.online/how-it-works): How de-vigging, arbitrage, and positive EV are calculated, with a worked example and a glossary
- [What is arbitrage betting?](https://www.betmandarin.online/what-is-arbitrage-betting): General explanation of arbitrage betting, the stake math, and the ways a "locked" profit can fail
- [Pricing](https://www.betmandarin.online/pricing): Plan comparison. Billing may be off during an open beta, in which case the product is free to use
- [Sign up](https://www.betmandarin.online/sign-up): Create an account
